704019b2490bd215.description:
About Us 
Parity is one of the world’s most experienced companies building the core infrastructure behind blockchain — the system that allows information and value to be shared securely without needing an intermediary. We’re laying the foundation for a better web which respects the freedom and data of individuals, and empowers developers to build better, more trustworthy online services.

Our remote-first, global team develop open-source software that anyone can use or improve. This includes Polkadot, Polkadot SDK, and Kusama — key parts of the Web3 tech stack, the next generation of the internet. Our mission is to make Polkadot the most active and innovative community in blockchain, powering a new era of connected and decentralised applications.

About the Team
Parity’s Security Engineering team is at the forefront of protecting the Polkadot ecosystem by designing and implementing secure software, auditing code for vulnerabilities, and building cutting-edge ML tools to automate security analysis. We work closely with development teams to embed security best practices across our open-source stack, ensuring that our blockchain infrastructure is robust, resilient, and secure by design.

About the Role
As a security-focused software engineer, you will go beyond traditional application security - you’ll audit and ideally write secure Rust code where needed, conduct deep manual and automated code audits, and leverage machine learning to enhance security across our ecosystem. This is an opportunity to shape the security landscape of the next generation of decentralized applications and protocols.
• 
Assist in developing Secure Software – Write and optimise Rust code to build security-critical components and tools.
• 
Code Auditing & Vulnerability Analysis – Perform deep manual and automated code reviews to identify and mitigate security vulnerabilities.
• 
ML-Powered Security – Design and implement machine learning models for automated security analysis, anomaly detection, and threat mitigation.
• 
Bug Bounty & Vulnerability Management – Manage bug bounty submissions, triage security reports, and collaborate with ethical hackers to resolve issues.
• 
Secure Development Best Practices – Work with engineering teams to integrate security best practices into the software development lifecycle.
• 
Threat Modeling & Risk Assessment – Identify and assess security risks in our blockchain infrastructure, smart contracts, and core software.
• 
Stay Cutting-Edge – Research and implement the latest advancements in secure coding, ML-driven security, and blockchain security.

What We're Looking For
• 
Experience with secure coding practices and memory safety concepts.
• 
Background in code auditing, vulnerability analysis, or exploit development.
• 
Experience triaging and resolving bug bounty reports.
• 
Knowledge of machine learning techniques applied to security (e.g., anomaly detection, fuzzing, automated threat detection).
• 
Familiarity with cryptographic principles, blockchain security, or decentralized systems.
• 
Strong problem-solving skills and an offensive security mindset.
If you're excited about writing secure software, auditing code, and pioneering ML-driven security solutions for Web3, we’d love to hear from you!

About Working With Us
Joining Parity means joining team mates who are genuinely excited about the impact their projects are having, and the opportunity to grow alongside some of the brightest minds in the Web3 space! You’ll work remotely and flexibly, while still getting to meet your team mates throughout the year at team and company-wide retreats.

Upon receiving an offer, all candidates undergo a background check through Zinc, our trusted third-party provider. Team members will be taken on as a contractor via our UK entity. View our Applicant Notice to see how we use your data.

Parity is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We welcome diversity in our global team and care about everyone in our collective feeling included and welcome.

Is this position not quite your match? Browse our other open roles.

707a255ccbbf2e18.description:
About Fyxer 
Fyxer launched in May 2024 and hit $1M in revenue across 3,000 paid users without spending a dollar on marketing. We've since gone from $1M to $30M ARR and raised a Series B led by Madrona, with Lakestar, 20VC and Marc Benioff behind us.

Far more people start using Fyxer every month than we can speak to. Nobody owns turning those users into paying teams. That's the biggest surface in the company, and it's this seat.

The role
You work accounts where someone is already using the product. One person trying Fyxer is often a door into a 500-person company. Spot those fast, get to the people who sign, prove out the pattern so it repeats.

You run the full cycle. First touch, discovery, demo, pricing, close. No handoffs.

You also write the first version of everything: the pitch, the sequences, the objection handling, the qualification bar. None of it exists yet. What you prove out is what the next reps get trained on.

What we're looking for
• 
High performer, president club pedigree seller who can name 30+ deals you closed yourself in the last 12 months 
• 
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to build and maintain relationships with stakeholders at all levels of an organization
• 
You've worked without a playbook, or built one where none existed
Three years in or twelve. We care what you've done, not where you did it.

How we work
Time with customers is the only thing that compounds. Everything else is overhead. We automate the research, the notes, the CRM and the follow-up with our own product. 
We move fast and decide in the meeting. You own your outcomes. We challenge each other directly. It's intense and it isn't for everyone.

The Fyxer Reality: Why We Win
• 
The Trajectory: We grew from $1M to $30M ARR with a team of just 32. 
• 
The Evidence: Ranked 7th in Andreessen Horowitz’s list of top AI apps. Every other company in that top 10 is valued at $10B+. We are the outlier.
• 
The Culture of Agency: We hire exceptional people, give them total ownership, and get out of their way.
• 
Zero Bureaucracy: No slow-motion decision-making. No "alignment" meetings for the sake of it.
 
This culture is intense; it requires focus and discipline. So we’ll do everything we can to remove distraction, support your wellbeing, and reward your impact 

The basics
• 
Remote, US

Compensation: $100K base / $200K OTE (plus equity, depending on location)
• 
Uncapped with accelerators above 100%. Reports to Alec Kraft, VP of Sales
• 
Travel: Occasional for enterprise customers

705ee7727c6f9be1.description: Ema has an open Machine Learning Engineer Intern position in Eluru for motivated freshers and final-year students. You will work on live applied machine learning and model deployment projects and finish with something you can genuinely talk about in interviews. About the role As a Machine Learning Engineer Intern at Ema, your core focus will be training, packaging and deploying machine-learning models into production. You are attached to a named mentor, join the team's stand-ups and reviews, and are trusted with work that matters rather than filler tasks. Questions are encouraged, your output is reviewed properly, and you get the feedback you need to actually improve. What you'll do day to day Work on training, packaging and deploying machine-learning models into production alongside the core team Use Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Model Deployment (MLOps), Feature Engineering on live, production-facing problems Turn your work into clear documentation, notes or decks for reviewers Take part in reviews and act on the feedback you receive Collaborate across functions engineering, product, design or business as the work demands Follow the team's quality, testing and documentation standards Track and report your own progress against an agreed plan Skills you'll build You will build practical, demonstrable experience in Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn, Model Deployment (MLOps), Feature Engineering, Pandas & NumPy, Model Evaluation Metrics, Docker, REST / gRPC Model Serving, Experiment Tracking (MLflow) the exact toolkit that separates a hireable fresher from a CV full of coursework. No prior work experience is required. Curiosity, problem-solving ability and a willingness to learn matter far more here than a polished rsum, and every one of these skills is taught on the job. Who should apply Students in their final year or recent graduates from B.E./B.Tech (CSE/IT/ECE), BCA, MCA, M.Sc (CS / Statistics) or M.Tech based in or willing to work from Eluru. You should be willing to learn Python, TensorFlow, Scikit-Learn and able to communicate clearly in writing. Personal projects, coursework, certifications or open-source contributions strengthen your application, but none of them are mandatory. Internship details This is a 3-month internship in Eluru, Andhra Pradesh, with a stipend of 36,000 per month. You will be given a defined project so that you leave with a model you trained, containerised and put behind a live endpoint. Working hours follow the team's normal business hours and the internship includes a certificate on successful completion. You will finish this internship with practical, demonstrable skills, real project work to point at, and a much clearer sense of how the industry actually operates day to day. Strong performers are considered for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) and a full-time role. How to apply Click Apply Now. If you are not logged in you will be asked to sign in and register first, after which you will be taken to Ema's official careers page to complete your application. Applications are reviewed on a rolling basis and seats are limited, so apply early. .
